description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shadow
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Shadow Fang (0~2), removed after using Apex Shadow Fang two times

description.name: Apex Shadow Fang Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Shadow Fang level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Dark abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shadow]

description.name: Apex Shadow Fang Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Shadow Fang level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shadow]
